orders.text:
CRLR No. 585 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Birendra Singh Adhikari, Advocate 
for the revisionist.
Mr. P.S. Bohra, Assistant Government 
Advocate has accepted notice on behalf of State 
of Uttarakhand/respondent no. 1. He may file 
his objection to the revision.
Heard.
Issue notice to respondent no. 2.
Steps to be taken within a period of ten 
days. Respondent no. 2 may file her response to 
the revision.
List this matter immediately after service 
of notice on the respondent no. 2 because as per 
the case of the revisionist is that even in the 
proceedings before the Court below he has 
sought to invoke the provision of Section 
125(3) Cr.P.C. wherein he has expressed his 
intention to discharge his matrimonial 
obligations. 
In that view of the matter, the parties to 
the revision are directed to appear in person on 
the next date fixed to be notified by the 
Registry.
Put up on the date fixed. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
10.10.2019
Navin

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 585 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Raj Kamal Prashar, Advocate for the 
revisionist.
Mr. P.S. Bohra, AGA for the State.
This matter was supposed to be listed for 
appearance of the parties for making an effort for 
mediation. The matter was scheduled to be listed 
yesterday but unfortunately, it couldn’t, hence the 
matter was posted today.
The revisionist is present in person but 
respondent No. 2, who has been served with the notice 
recently i.e. on 24.11.2019, is not present. 
In such an eventuality the matter is directed to be 
posted on 10.02.2020. The Registry is directed to send 
the information about the aforesaid date fixed to 
respondent No. 2, in order to ensure her presence.
 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
26.11.2019 Mahinder/
